about: RankUp starter bounties. stars = hardest move; minutes = estimate (holds, reps at 1.5-2.5 s, breaths 10 s, sides doubled, sets and rest, +10 s per move); tier = card time label.

bounties.title: Ignition
bounties.plain: A 5-minute full-body warm-up for any day

moves.name: Jumping jacks
moves.cue: Land soft on the balls of your feet, arms all the way overhead

moves.name: Arm circles
moves.cue: Small to big circles, then reverse; keep ribs down

moves.name: Leg swings (front to back)
moves.cue: Hold a wall, swing from the hip, keep torso still

moves.name: Glute bridges
moves.cue: Ribs down, drive through heels, squeeze 1 s at the top

moves.name: Walking knee hugs
moves.cue: Pull knee to chest, rise onto the standing toes
